questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "Research suggests that passion isn't a fixed trait—it can be nurtured and revived." in the second paragraph?
options: Passion is an unchangeable trait that cannot be regained once lost
Studies indicate that passion is something people are born with and cannot develop over time
Rather than being a permanent characteristic, passion can be cultivated and restored
Instead of losing passion, people should focus on changing their careers
When experiencing a lack of passion, individuals need to give up rather than revive it
questions.correctAnswer: Rather than being a permanent characteristic, passion can be cultivated and restored

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "For some, losing passion for work might signal the need for a career change, but such a drastic move isn't always realistic." in the second paragraph?
options: Losing passion for work always means that a career change is necessary
Some people think switching careers is the best way to regain passion, but it is not always practical solution
Instead of staying in the same job, people should immediately change careers when they lose passion
Rather than considering a career change, workers must accept that passion cannot return
When feeling unmotivated, individuals need to find a new job rather than trying to restore their passion
questions.correctAnswer: Some people think switching careers is the best way to regain passion, but it is not always practical solution

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "Watching my thoughts take shape on a blank page was exhilarating, and from that moment, I was hooked." in the first paragraph?
options: Writing my ideas down was thrilling, and I became passionate about it instantly
Instead of feeling excited, I was uncertain about my thoughts appearing on paper
Rather than being interested in writing, I was frustrated by my early attempts
My thoughts were difficult to put into words, making writing less enjoyable
When trying to write, I felt unsure about whether I would enjoy it
questions.correctAnswer: Writing my ideas down was thrilling, and I became passionate about it instantly

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "Now, as an author and journalist, I recognize how fortunate I am to have turned that childhood dream into a career." in the first paragraph?
options: My career as an author and journalist has been shaped by unexpected opportunities rather than a childhood dream
Achieving my goal of becoming a writer required many adjustments along the way
Becoming a writer has made me appreciate that my early passion turned into a profession
The journey to becoming an author and journalist involved challenges that reshaped my original aspirations
Pursuing a career in writing allowed me to explore different aspects of storytelling beyond my initial expectations
questions.correctAnswer: Becoming a writer has made me appreciate that my early passion turned into a profession

questions.text: Another way of saying the sentence "At times, it's as if I'm stuck on an endless treadmill, desperate to step off." In paragraph 2 is that ...
options: My routine constantly changes, making it hard to stay consistent
There are moments when I enjoy the steady rhythm of my work
I find excitement in the unpredictable nature of my daily tasks
The challenges of my job make me more eager to keep going
I sometimes feel trapped in a repetitive cycle and want a break
questions.correctAnswer: I sometimes feel trapped in a repetitive cycle and want a break

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "Recent studies highlight how some people naturally apply 'cultivation strategies' to rekindle their motivation"?
options: Research has proven that everyone is capable of reigniting their drive through natural techniques
Some individuals instinctively use specific methods to regain their enthusiasm, as shown in recent research
Studies have demonstrated that motivation can only be restored through structured strategies
The latest research shows that people must develop new skills to maintain their motivation
Some studies suggest that individuals struggle to find effective ways to restore their passion
questions.correctAnswer: Some individuals instinctively use specific methods to regain their enthusiasm, as shown in recent research

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "Ever since I first borrowed my parents' old typewriter at the age of six, I knew I wanted to be a writer."?
options: From the moment I used my parents' typewriter as a child, I realized that writing was my passion
Using a typewriter at six years old made me understand that becoming a writer was my destiny
My parents encouraged me to become a writer by letting me use their old typewriter as a kid
I became interested in writing only after frequently using my parents' typewriter in childhood
Learning to use a typewriter at a young age led me to explore different career paths, including writing
questions.correctAnswer: From the moment I used my parents' typewriter as a child, I realized that writing was my passion

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "Kawakami is just one of many rural villages struggling with depopulation as Japan's urban migration accelerates." In paragraph 2?
options: The movement of people to Japanese cities has left villages like Kawakami facing a population decline
As more people relocate to urban areas in Japan, villages such as Kawakami are growing in size
Japan's rural regions, including Kawakami, are witnessing a population boom due to urban migration
Many villages like Kawakami are thriving as Japan's city population continues to increase
The rise in rural populations has caused urban migration to become a concern in Japan
questions.correctAnswer: The movement of people to Japanese cities has left villages like Kawakami facing a population decline

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "Meanwhile, rural industries such as agriculture and forestry face a growing labor crisis." in paragraph 2?
options: Agriculture and forestry are no longer the primary jobs for rural residents
The rise of urban migration has led to the growth of rural industries
The workforce shortage is becoming a major challenge for Japan's rural industries
Many people in rural areas prefer working in industries like agriculture and forestry
The labor force in Japan's rural industries has remained stable despite migration
questions.correctAnswer: The workforce shortage is becoming a major challenge for Japan's rural industries

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the main idea of the text "Japan's declining population, driven by urban migration and low birth rates, threatens the country's economic and social stability."?
options: Japan's economy and society are at risk due to a shrinking population caused by migration and low birth rates
The increase in Japan's population, along with urban migration, has strengthened the nation's economy
Japan's social and economic growth is being driven by low birth rates and the movement of people to cities
Despite concerns over urban migration and low birth rates, Japan has taken steps to maintain economic and social stability
The movement of people to cities and fewer births have contributed to a decline in Japan's population
questions.correctAnswer: Japan's economy and society are at risk due to a shrinking population caused by migration and low birth rates

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "Today, more than 90% of Japanese residents live in major cities like Tokyo, Osaka, and Kyoto, connected by the country's famously punctual Shinkansen bullet trains." in paragraph 2?
options: Nearly 90% of Japan's population depends on Shinkansen bullet trains to commute between cities like Tokyo, Osaka, and Kyoto
The expansion of the Shinkansen network has led to more than 90% of Japan's population moving to urban areas
In modern Japan, over 90% of residents have chosen to live in major cities like Tokyo, Osaka, and Kyoto, all of which are served by the Shinkansen
Due to increased urbanization, Shinkansen trains have become the main mode of transport for more than 90% of Japan's residents in cities like Tokyo and Osaka
The majority of Japan's population, exceeding 90%, is now concentrated in key metropolitan areas such as Tokyo and Osaka, where Shinkansen trains operate
questions.correctAnswer: In modern Japan, over 90% of residents have chosen to live in major cities like Tokyo, Osaka, and Kyoto, all of which are served by the Shinkansen

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "Yet Japan's demographic crisis extends beyond the countryside—people in cities aren't having babies either." in paragraph 3?
options: Japan's population decline is not just a rural issue, as urban residents also have low birth rates
The decreasing birth rate in Japan is only happening in major cities, while rural areas remain unaffected
While urban populations are stable, rural communities are struggling with declining birth rates
Japan's demographic problems started in rural areas but have now spread to cities, where birth rates used to be high
The main reason for Japan's demographic crisis is that more people are moving from rural areas to the cities
questions.correctAnswer: Japan's population decline is not just a rural issue, as urban residents also have low birth rates

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "As time runs out to reverse these trends, Japan faces an uncertain future, with its shrinking population threatening the nation’s economic and social stability." in paragraph 3?
options: Japan’s economy and society are collapsing due to its rapidly shrinking population
The uncertain future of Japan is mainly caused by economic problems rather than population decline
Japan is running out of time to prevent its population from decreasing, which will cause permanent damage to the country
Without immediate action, Japan’s growing population will continue to strain its economy and society
Japan’s declining population, if not addressed soon, could jeopardize both its economy and social structure

questions.text: Which of the following best restates the sentence "Over the past quarter-century, Kawakami’s population has dwindled from 6,000 to just 1,150 as younger generations left for the cities, leaving behind abandoned homes, some overtaken by wildlife." in paragraph 1?
options: In the last 25 years, despite some residents moving to the cities, Kawakami’s population stayed close to 6,000, though several homes became vacant and nature slowly took over

Over the past 25 years, Kawakami’s population has sharply fallen from 6,000 to only 1,150, as many young residents migrated to urban areas, resulting in numerous deserted houses, some reclaimed by nature
Over the past quarter century, Kawakami’s population dropped from 6,000 to 1,150 mainly because older residents left for urban centers, leaving behind a number of abandoned houses
During the last 25 years, a modest decline occurred in Kawakami’s population as many older inhabitants relocated to cities, which led to a few empty homes being overtaken by wildlife
Over the past 25 years, Kawakami experienced a significant population decrease from 6,000 to 1,150 primarily due to economic downturns, resulting in numerous abandoned homes reclaimed by nature

questions.text: "The latest Tony and Gerry could get away would be the 13th." Which of the following best restates the sentence?
options: Tony and Gerry are permitted to depart only on the 13th.
The earliest day Tony and Gerry can leave is the 13th.
Tony and Gerry must plan to get away before the 13th.
Tony and Gerry cannot leave after the 13th.
Tony and Gerry are scheduled to leave on the 13th as their sole option.
